method: Verified SHA-256, byte size, PDF readability and actual page count for all 9 supplied files and all 158 pages.

Read embedded text from every page and applied CUDA-accelerated OCR to all 11 pages below the text threshold; five sparse scanned pages produced readable OCR and six trailing spreadsheet-export pages were verified as visually blank.

Rendered and visually inspected the complete 158-page sequence in seven contact sheets; every document begins with substantive content, no first page is blank and no corrupt or truncated page was found.
Compared every supplied hash against every published evidence catalog and identified eight exact SHA-256 matches.

Compared the byte-distinct September 2025 Pace report against established PFAS record 063-95e40af937e2 at the page-image and extracted-text levels; all 16 page renders and all 16 text streams are exact matches, so the supplied file is a content-identical re-export rather than a distinct revision.
Kept both Plant Sewer Lines files associated with their separate established records because their hashes and published record roles are distinct; no supplied PDF was modified.
